audit_boundaries: read_document is an internal authoring/review primitive; it is not an audience-facing current-selection endpoint.
Legacy docs impact/reference audit selects investigation candidates, including stale records; S04 replaces its acknowledgement/touched-file freshness semantics.
Foundry Platform/Vault search, storage, promotion and authentication APIs are unchanged and not recertified by this portable resolver.
migration: Unmanaged legacy Markdown remains byte-preserved and is never promoted from ACTIVE alone. No exact release selection means no current document guidance; source policies/registry still load as control inputs. Existing AGENTS/CLAUDE host instructions remain authoritative.
